title: Cover reminderSyncEffect's D1/D2 guards with a real ProviderContainer test instead of overdue_notifications_test.dart's hand-duplicated logic

evidence.quote: /// O8 is a REAL characterisation test — it targets code that EXISTS today
// We call scheduler.cancel() directly to show the EXPECTED call;

why: None of O8-a..d builds a ProviderContainer or overrides allDailyTasksProvider to invoke the actual reminderSyncEffect provider, contradicting the file's own docstring claim. O8-b calls scheduler.cancel() directly rather than exercising the 'if (taskCount == 0)' guard in production; O8-d hand-retypes the today-only filter instead of calling it. A regression that deletes or inverts notification_providers.dart:517-520's zero-count cancel guard, or that misses excluding a new DailyTaskPriority from the today-only filter, ships with dart test fully green. Sibling file reminder_sync_sacred_time_test.dart proves reminderSyncEffect IS reachable for real testing via allDailyTasksProvider.overrideWith(...) — this file simply doesn't use that technique for D1/D2.
recommendation: Rewrite O8-b/O8-d to build a ProviderContainer with allDailyTasksProvider and the notification gateway/scheduler provider overridden, read reminderSyncEffectProvider, and assert against the recording gateway the effect actually drove (mirror reminder_sync_sacred_time_test.dart's pattern). Delete the unused MockNotificationGateway/mocktail import.
acceptance_criteria: At least one test in the file invokes reminderSyncEffect/reminderSyncEffectProvider through a real ProviderContainer.
A mutation deleting the taskCount == 0 guard in notification_providers.dart fails this test file.
The unused MockNotificationGateway class and its mocktail import are removed or put to use.

corrections: Quote at 'line 263' is actually at line 260; the line-452 quote spans lines 453-454 in the formatted source, not one line. Content is real, just mis-cited.
